d:
A heartfelt celebration of the unbreakable bond between brothers and sisters, Raksha Bandhan captures the warmth, love, and timeless emotions of this special relationship.
Song: Raksha Bandhan (Title Track)
Music: Himesh Reshammiya
Lyrics: Irshad Kamil
Singer: Shreya Ghoshal
Music Programmers: Suhas Parab, Subhash Parab, Priyesh Vakil, Barzin Contractor & Pratik Panchal
Guitar: Chintoo Singh Wazir
Flute: Kiran Vinkar
